profile.name: Neousys CAN总线接口
profile.description: 这是一种由 Neousys 提供的 CAN 总线通信接口，用于在实验室或工业测试环境中与各类 CAN 设备进行数据收发。它常用于连接控制器、传感器、执行器或被测设备，以进行设备联调、总线通信测试和自动化控制集成。
profile.description_en: This is a CAN bus communication interface from Neousys, used in laboratory or industrial test setups to transmit and receive data with CAN devices. It is commonly used to connect controllers, sensors, actuators, or devices under test for system integration, bus communication testing, and automation control.
